Thursday to Sunday, the Moon in your 7th House opposes Uranus in your 11th House, bringing a surprising partner message, while Mercury sextiles your 10th House, helping a money negotiation succeed. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines Jupiter in your 1st House. Tuesday is your worst day because Mercury squares Saturn in your 9th House. Guard your water-sign energy by refusing one draining home request this week. Follow for daily updates.
